## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueLoneTemplate`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/no-lone-template`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/no-lone-template)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueLoneTemplate": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow `<template>` elements in a Vue template that don't use `v-if`, `v-else-if`, `v-else`, `v-for`, or `v-slot`.

Inside a Vue template, a `<template>` element is an invisible wrapper only
when it has one of these directives. Without one, Vue renders it as a
regular HTML `<template>` element, and the browser doesn't show its
content on the page.

The `<template>` at the top level of a `.vue` file isn't checked.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<template>
  <template>
    <p>Hello</p>
  </template>
</template>
```

### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <template v-if="visible">
    <p>Hello</p>
  </template>
  <template v-else>
    <p>Goodbye</p>
  </template>
  <template v-for="item in items">
    <p>{{ item }}</p>
  </template>
  <MyList>
    <template #item>
      <p>Item</p>
    </template>
  </MyList>
</template>
```

## Options

### `ignoreAccessible`

Default: `false`

When `true`, a `<template>` without one of these directives is allowed
if it has an `id` or `ref` attribute, written plainly or bound with
`v-bind`. Use this when your code reads the `<template>` element on purpose,
for example to copy its content.

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueLoneTemplate": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"ignoreAccessible": true
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

#### Invalid

<template>
  <template class="row">
    <p>Cell</p>
  </template>
</template>

#### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <template id="row">
    <p>Cell</p>
  </template>
  <template ref="rowTemplate">
    <p>Cell</p>
  </template>
</template>
```
